text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, no matter how many times I re-stick 
it, it's crooked.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
5 more millimeters to the right. ...Too 
far. 2 millimeters back to the left.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Why? No matter what I do, the bottom edge 
just won't sit parallel to the floor."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Could this handout...! Have been cut 
carelessly?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The corner is... I knew it! Looking 
closely, it's not a right angle. 
Unbelievable.
